item.title: AllSkills
item.description: AllSkills is a Skills mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Unlocks all skills at once — for players who want the full build without the grind. What it does Unlocks every skill at once For players who want the full build without the grind Consider it a cheat-lite — affects progression balance How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe.
